hooks.command: Set-Location 'd:\Dropshippingv0.1tool'; git add -A; $staged = git diff --cached --name-only; if ($staged) { $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; git commit -m "auto: $ts"; $branch = git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; git push origin $branch; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '[hook] push geweigerd - ophalen en opnieuw proberen'; git pull --rebase --autostash origin $branch; git push origin $branch } }
